The '''Belcantese-Northern Alliance Treaty of 1891''' was a diplomatic agreement between the [[United Kingdoms of Belcanto]] and the [[Northern Alliance]]. Source material identifies it as the immediate political trigger for the [[Belcanto Campaign]].

== Significance ==

The treaty placed Belcanto closer to an anti-Vesperan alignment at a time when the [[Vesperan Empire]] was expanding and consolidating strategic trade routes. Vesperan officials treated the agreement as a threat to imperial interests.

== Consequence ==

The treaty did not cause the conquest by itself. It gave Vespera a pretext and strategic warning point for action against a region it already considered valuable for ports, resources, trade routes, and defensive geography.
